Joe Redner, Tampa's famous strip club owner, joins Danny Jones for episode 37 of the KONCRETE podcast. Redner built an empire of neon in Florida and fought city hall for decades over free speech. His clubs and his court battles made him a local legend.

Redner tells the story of his fights under the First Amendment, which he treats as a personal creed. He recounts arrests, lawsuits, and the politics of vice in a Southern city. Jones asks what keeps him fighting after so many years. Bold and free-minded listeners get a Florida original in full voice.
